functionDeclarations.name: get_invoice_context
functionDeclarations.description: Read authoritative invoice approval, hold flag and approved payment facts before deciding.

functionDeclarations.name: get_payment_status
functionDeclarations.description: Read authoritative durable payment workflow state. VERIFIED establishes that the approved payment request was accepted and verified. Settlement is outside this demo.

functionDeclarations.name: submit_payment
functionDeclarations.description: Request submission or recovery of the same approved invoice payment. Application policy and stable operation identity protect repeated requests. UNKNOWN means completion was not observed; use status lookup or repeat this tool for the same invoice.
